title: Early INVALID_PARAM return in oscore_ctx_get skips *ctx_out=NULL sentinel
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_ctx.c:697-701. The recipient_id NULL+len>0 check returns before setting sentinel; sibling get_by_eui64 sets after combined check. Move *ctx_out=NULL directly after ctx_out NULL check completing worker6-x3bc intent.
close_reason: oscore_ctx_get(): *ctx_out=NULL hoisted directly after ctx_out NULL check so the recipient_id INVALID_PARAM early return now leaves the sentinel set; mirrors get_by_eui64 ordering. Note: HEAD had no sentinel at all; a concurrent working-tree edit had added it after the second check which still skipped it on that path - completed as true hoist.
